arithmetic: Fraction and directed integer rounding on a 10^30 grid; float only for CSV display
energy_scope: Unconditional subcluster lower bounds. The combined envelope additionally imports the published Yuhjtman stability theorem, E_N >= -14.316*N; that analytic proof is not rerun here. No claim of exhaustive latest-literature dominance.

published_stability_source.title: A Sensible Estimate for the Stability Constant of the Lennard-Jones Potential

diameter_scope: Strict diameter upper bounds for global minimizers. Endpoint bounds also hold throughout the feasible sublevel.
baseline_scope: KS pair-layer formula recomputed with the valid v(d-1) kernel and the same half-open convention. Not a rerun of BARON or the published C code.
surplus_relaxation: All integer partitions enumerated. Sorted products paired with contiguous-site kernel upper bounds. No assumed optimal arrangement.
